steps: Peel the sweet potato and cut into 2 cm cubes.
Dice the onion finely and mince the garlic cloves.
Cut the white fish (cod) into 3 cm chunks, removing any bones.
Heat olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat.
Cook the onion and garlic for 3 minutes, until softened.
Add sweet potato cubes and turmeric; stir and cook 2 minutes.
Pour in the unsalted vegetable broth; cover and cook 10 minutes, until sweet potato is tender.
Nestle the cod chunks into the pan; cover and cook 5 to 6 minutes, until fish flakes easily.
Stir in the spinach and lemon juice; cook 1 minute until wilted.
Break cod into smaller pieces before serving. Makes 4 family portions; refrigerate up to 2 days.
